- `[tiab]` looks for the word in each record's title or abstract (and the authors' keywords). It finds papers that use the word even without a subject heading such as `"Pain"[Mesh]`, which a recent record may not have yet.
- The star `*` means any word ending: `vaccin*` finds vaccine, vaccines, vaccination and vaccinated; `anxi*` finds anxiety and anxious. It can also catch unwanted words (`pain*` finds painting), so we check what it adds.
